

===== index.html =====
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" dir="ltr">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Finora</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
</head>
<body data-page="home">
<div class="shell">

<aside class="sidebar">
  <div class="brand">
    <span class="brand-mark">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
        <path d="M6 16c4.5 0 8-3.5 8-8-4.5 0-8 3.5-8 8Z"/><path d="M10 14c2.5 0 5 1.7 6 4"/>
      </svg>
    </span>
    <div><strong>Finora</strong><small data-en="Financial clarity, made simple." data-ar="وضوح مالي ببساطة.">Financial clarity, made simple.</small></div>
  </div>
  <div class="side-top">
    <a data-nav="home" href="index.html" data-en="Home" data-ar="الرئيسية">Home</a>
    <a data-nav="about" href="about.html" data-en="About" data-ar="عن Finora">About</a>
  </div>
  <div class="side-label" data-en="Tools" data-ar="الأدوات">Tools</div>
  <div id="sidebarMenus" class="side-menu"></div>
</aside>
<div id="overlay" class="overlay"></div>

<main class="main">

<header class="topbar">
  <button class="menu-btn" onclick="toggleNav()" aria-label="Menu">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M4 7h16M4 12h16M4 17h16"/></svg>
  </button>
  <div class="breadcrumb">Finora</div>
  <div class="lang">
    <button data-lang="en" onclick="setLang('en')">EN</button>
    <button data-lang="ar" onclick="setLang('ar')">ع</button>
  </div>
</header>


<section class="hero">
  <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="">
  <div class="hero-copy">
    <small data-en="Financial & accounting workspace" data-ar="مساحة عمل مالية ومحاسبية">Financial & accounting workspace</small>
    <h1>Finora</h1>
    <p data-en="Financial clarity, made simple. Practical tools for everyday financial and accounting decisions."
       data-ar="وضوح مالي ببساطة. أدوات عملية للقرارات المالية والمحاسبية اليومية.">
       Financial clarity, made simple. Practical tools for everyday financial and accounting decisions.
    </p>
    <button class="primary-btn" onclick="location.href='explore.html'" data-en="Start to Explore" data-ar="ابدأ الاستكشاف">Start to Explore</button>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="visual-panel">
  <div class="visual-copy">
    <small data-en="Workspace overview" data-ar="نظرة عامة">Workspace overview</small>
    <h2 data-en="Financial clarity, built into every tool." data-ar="وضوح مالي داخل كل أداة.">Financial clarity, built into every tool.</h2>
    <p data-en="Move from calculation to insight with a focused set of financial and accounting tools."
       data-ar="انتقل من الحساب إلى الفهم من خلال مجموعة مركزة من الأدوات المالية والمحاسبية.">
       Move from calculation to insight with a focused set of financial and accounting tools.
    </p>
  </div>
  <svg class="linechart" viewBox="0 0 900 260" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">
    <defs>
      <linearGradient id="homeLine" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="rgba(255,255,255,.25)"/><stop offset="60%" stop-color="rgba(255,255,255,.95)"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c4a66a"/></linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="homeArea" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="rgba(255,255,255,.12)"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="rgba(255,255,255,0)"/></linearGradient>
    </defs>
    <g class="gridline"><path d="M0 52H900M0 104H900M0 156H900M0 208H900"/><path d="M120 0V260M260 0V260M400 0V260M540 0V260M680 0V260M820 0V260"/></g>
    <path class="chart-area" d="M0 220 C80 216 120 180 184 188 S292 144 352 157 S450 111 515 124 S618 75 681 91 S792 50 900 60 L900 260 L0 260 Z"/>
    <path class="chart-line" d="M0 220 C80 216 120 180 184 188 S292 144 352 157 S450 111 515 124 S618 75 681 91 S792 50 900 60"/>
    <g class="chart-points"><circle cx="184" cy="188" r="4"/><circle cx="352" cy="157" r="4"/><circle cx="515" cy="124" r="4"/><circle cx="681" cy="91" r="4"/><circle cx="900" cy="60" r="4"/></g>
  </svg>
</section>

<div class="home-lower">
  <div class="stat-row">
    <div class="stat"><strong>37</strong><span data-en="Financial tools" data-ar="أداة مالية">Financial tools</span></div>
    <div class="stat"><strong>7</strong><span data-en="Core sections" data-ar="أقسام رئيسية">Core sections</span></div>
    <div class="stat"><strong data-en="Fast" data-ar="سريع">Fast</strong><span data-en="Instant calculations" data-ar="حسابات فورية">Instant calculations</span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="bars">
    <h3 data-en="Toolkit coverage" data-ar="تغطية الأدوات">Toolkit coverage</h3>
    <p data-en="A visual look at Finora's financial sections." data-ar="نظرة بصرية على أقسام Finora المالية.">A visual look at Finora's financial sections.</p>
    <div class="bar-wrap">
      <div class="bar-item"><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="height:70%"></div></div><span>MKT</span></div>
      <div class="bar-item"><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="height:86%"></div></div><span>ACC</span></div>
      <div class="bar-item"><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="height:100%"></div></div><span>RAT</span></div>
      <div class="bar-item"><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="height:72%"></div></div><span>BUD</span></div>
      <div class="bar-item"><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="height:88%"></div></div><span>INV</span></div>
      <div class="bar-item"><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="height:58%"></div></div><span>LOAN</span></div>
      <div class="bar-item"><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="height:62%"></div></div><span>CASH</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="home-foot-grid">
  <section class="simple-panel"><h3 data-en="Popular Tools" data-ar="الأدوات الشائعة">Popular Tools</h3><div id="popularList" class="link-list"></div></section>
  <section class="simple-panel"><h3 data-en="Recently Used" data-ar="المستخدمة مؤخرًا">Recently Used</h3><div id="recentList"></div></section>
</div>

</main>
</div>
<script src="app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

    <section id="inputPanel" class="calc-panel mobile-active">

      <button class="calc-btn" onclick="calculateTool()" data-en="Calculate" data-ar="احسب">Calculate</button>
    </section>

    <section id="resultPanel" class="calc-panel">
      <h2 data-en="Results" data-ar="النتائج">Results</h2>
      <div id="results"></div>
      <div id="formula" class="formula"></div>
      <button class="edit-btn" onclick="showCalcTab('inputs')" data-en="Edit inputs" data-ar="تعديل المدخلات">Edit inputs</button>
    </section>
  </div>
</section>

</main>
</div>
<script src="app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

    <p data-en="Each section groups related tools so the user can reach the right calculation without navigating a crowded page."

       Each section groups related tools so the user can reach the right calculation without navigating a crowded page.
    </p>
  </section>
  <section id="aboutList" class="about-list"></section>
</div>

</main>
</div>

===== styles.css =====

:root{
  --g950:#071f18;
  --g900:#0b3025;
  --g800:#104835;
  --g700:#176047;
  --g600:#1f7958;
  --g500:#2d936a;
  --paper:#f7f8f5;
  --white:#fff;
  --ink:#15271f;
  --muted:#718078;
  --line:#dfe8e2;
  --gold:#c4a66a;
  --shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(7,31,24,.08);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  margin:0;
  font-family:Inter,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;
  color:var(--ink);
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 8% 8%,rgba(45,147,106,.10),transparent 27%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 92% 20%,rgba(196,166,106,.08),transparent 22%),
    linear-gradient(135deg,#fbfdfc 0%,#eef5f1 50%,#f8f5ee 100%);
  min-height:100vh;
}
html[dir=rtl] body{font-family:"Tajawal","Segoe UI",Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif}
a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
button,input{font:inherit}
.shell{display:flex;min-height:100vh}

/* Sidebar */
.sidebar{
  position:fixed;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:264px;
  padding:22px 14px 24px;overflow:auto;z-index:40;color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#071f18 0%,#0b3025 53%,#104835 100%);
  box-shadow:12px 0 40px rgba(7,31,24,.10);
}
.brand{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;
  padding:2px 8px 18px;margin-bottom:10px;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10)
}
.brand-mark{
  width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:12px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.09)
}
.brand-mark svg{width:22px;height:22px}
.brand strong{display:block;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:-.4px}
.brand small{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);font-size:9px}
.side-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px;margin:0 0 12px}
.side-top a{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:9px;border-radius:10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:750;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.78);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)
}
.side-top a:hover,.side-top a.active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.13);color:#fff}
.side-label{
  margin:12px 8px 7px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.38);
  font-size:8px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:1.2px;text-transform:uppercase
}
.side-menu details{margin:3px 0}
.side-menu summary{
  list-style:none;cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
  padding:9px;border-radius:10px;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.83);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700
}
.side-menu summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.side-menu summary:hover,.side-menu details[open] summary{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#fff}
.side-icon{
  width:27px;height:27px;border-radius:8px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);color:#ddf0e6
}
.side-icon svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.side-cat-name{flex:1}
.side-cat-link{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
.side-tools{padding:3px 5px 4px}
.side-tools a{
  display:block;padding:7px 10px 7px 42px;border-radius:8px;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.58);font-size:10.5px
}
html[dir=rtl] .side-tools a{padding:7px 42px 7px 10px}
.side-tools a:hover,.side-tools a.active{background:rgba(45,147,106,.17);color:#fff}

/* Main + header */
.main{margin-left:264px;width:calc(100% - 264px);padding:18px 24px 36px}
.topbar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;
  margin-bottom:17px
}
.menu-btn{
  display:none;width:42px;height:42px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;
  background:#fff;color:var(--g900);place-items:center;cursor:pointer
}
.menu-btn svg{width:19px;height:19px}
.breadcrumb{min-width:0;color:#87938d;font-size:10px}
.lang{
  display:flex;padding:3px;border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:11px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 5px 15px rgba(7,31,24,.04)
}
.lang button{
  border:0;background:transparent;padding:7px 9px;min-width:37px;
  border-radius:8px;color:#64756c;font-size:10px;font-weight:850;cursor:pointer
}
.lang button.active{background:var(--g900);color:#fff}
.overlay{display:none}

/* Common page headers */
.page-head{max-width:820px;margin-bottom:22px}
.eyebrow{
  display:block;margin-bottom:7px;color:var(--g600);
  font-size:9px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:1.2px;text-transform:uppercase
}
.page-head h1{
  margin:0;color:var(--g950);font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,48px);
  line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-1.3px
}
.page-head p{margin:10px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.65}

/* Home */
.hero{
  position:relative;min-height:330px;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;
  background:var(--g900);box-shadow:var(--shadow)
}
.hero img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center}
.hero:after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(5,26,20,.92),rgba(5,26,20,.62) 43%,rgba(5,26,20,.12) 76%)
}
html[dir=rtl] .hero:after{
  background:linear-gradient(270deg,rgba(5,26,20,.92),rgba(5,26,20,.62) 43%,rgba(5,26,20,.12) 76%)
}
.hero-copy{
  position:relative;z-index:2;min-height:330px;width:min(620px,62%);
  padding:40px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;color:#fff
}
.hero-copy small{color:rgba(255,255,255,.62);font-size:9px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.1px;text-transform:uppercase}
.hero-copy h1{margin:10px 0 9px;font-size:47px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-1.6px}
.hero-copy p{margin:0;max-width:480px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.70);font-size:13px;line-height:1.65}
.primary-btn{
  width:max-content;margin-top:21px;border:0;border-radius:11px;padding:11px 15px;
  background:#fff;color:var(--g900);font-weight:850;font-size:10.5px;cursor:pointer
}
.visual-panel{
  position:relative;min-height:285px;margin-top:14px;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;
  color:#fff;background:
  radial-gradient(circle at 90% 10%,rgba(196,166,106,.18),transparent 24%),
  linear-gradient(135deg,#0b3025 0%,#14513d 58%,#1f7958 100%);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow)
}
.visual-copy{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:28px;top:27px;width:min(430px,46%)}
html[dir=rtl] .visual-copy{left:auto;right:28px}
.visual-copy small{color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);font-size:8.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase}
.visual-copy h2{margin:9px 0 10px;font-size:28px;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.8px}
.visual-copy p{margin:0;color:rgba(255,255,255,.67);font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.65}
.linechart{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:0;width:58%;height:78%}
html[dir=rtl] .linechart{right:auto;left:0;transform:scaleX(-1)}
.gridline{stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.07);stroke-width:1}
.chart-area{fill:url(#homeArea)}
.chart-line{fill:none;stroke:url(#homeLine);stroke-width:3;stroke-linecap:round}
.chart-points circle{fill:#fff;stroke:#c4a66a;stroke-width:2}
.home-lower{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:14px}
.stat-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px}
.stat{
  min-height:126px;padding:16px;border:1px solid rgba(20,58,45,.08);
  border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);box-shadow:var(--shadow)
}
.stat strong{display:block;margin-top:25px;color:var(--g950);font-size:24px}
.stat span{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:#7d8a83;font-size:9.5px}
.bars{
  padding:19px 21px;border:1px solid rgba(20,58,45,.08);
  border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);box-shadow:var(--shadow)
}
.bars h3{margin:0;color:var(--g950);font-size:14px}
.bars p{margin:4px 0 0;color:#8a9690;font-size:9px}
.bar-wrap{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:11px;height:140px;margin-top:13px}
.bar-item{flex:1;text-align:center}
.bar-track{height:110px;max-width:34px;margin:0 auto 7px;border-radius:9px;background:#edf2ef;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;overflow:hidden}
.bar-fill{width:100%;border-radius:9px 9px 0 0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--g500),var(--g700))}
.bar-item:nth-child(4) .bar-fill{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#d0b57c,#a88a51)}
.bar-item span{color:#909c95;font-size:7px;font-weight:750}
.home-foot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:14px}
.simple-panel{
  padding:18px;border:1px solid rgba(20,58,45,.08);
  border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);box-shadow:var(--shadow)
}
.simple-panel h3{margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--g950);font-size:13px}
.link-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.link-list a,.recent-link{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;
  padding:10px 2px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:10.5px;color:#58675f
}
.link-list a:last-child,.recent-link:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.link-list a:hover,.recent-link:hover{color:var(--g700)}

/* Explore categories */
.category-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:13px}
.category-card{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;padding:18px;
  border:1px solid rgba(20,58,45,.08);border-radius:18px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.90);box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:.16s
}
.category-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:rgba(31,121,88,.24)}
.cat-icon{
  width:42px;height:42px;flex:none;border-radius:12px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;background:#e2eee7;color:var(--g700)
}
.cat-icon svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.category-card strong{display:block;color:var(--g950);font-size:13px}
.category-card p{margin:4px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:9.5px;line-height:1.45}
.category-card .go-arrow{margin-left:auto;color:#9aa69f;font-size:18px}
html[dir=rtl] .category-card .go-arrow{margin-left:0;margin-right:auto;transform:scaleX(-1)}

/* Category tools */
.tool-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:11px}
.tool-card{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;
  padding:16px;border:1px solid rgba(20,58,45,.08);border-radius:16px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.90);box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:.16s
}
.tool-card:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);border-color:rgba(31,121,88,.24)}
.tool-card strong{display:block;color:var(--g950);font-size:12px}
.tool-card p{margin:4px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:9px;line-height:1.4}
.tool-arrow{color:#9aa69f;font-size:18px}
html[dir=rtl] .tool-arrow{transform:scaleX(-1)}

/* Dedicated calculator page */
.tool-page{height:calc(100dvh - 76px);min-height:520px;display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr;gap:12px}
.tool-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:11px}
.back-btn{
  width:38px;height:38px;flex:none;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;background:#fff;color:var(--g900);cursor:pointer
}
.back-btn svg{width:17px;height:17px}
html[dir=rtl] .back-btn svg{transform:scaleX(-1)}
.tool-head h1{margin:0;color:var(--g950);font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.6px}
.tool-head p{margin:5px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.45}
.calc-grid{min-height:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr .88fr;gap:12px}
.calc-panel{
  min-height:0;overflow:auto;padding:18px;border:1px solid rgba(20,58,45,.09);
  border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);box-shadow:var(--shadow)
}
.calc-panel h2{margin:0 0 13px;color:var(--g900);font-size:13px}
.fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px 12px}
.field-wrap label{
  display:block;min-height:26px;margin-bottom:4px;color:#5d6c64;
  font-size:9.5px;font-weight:760;line-height:1.3
}
.field{
  width:100%;height:42px;padding:9px 11px;border:1px solid #d9e3dd;
  border-radius:10px;background:#fbfcfb;outline:none;color:var(--ink);font-size:12px
}
.field:focus{border-color:#8ebba6;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(31,121,88,.08)}
.calc-btn{
  width:100%;margin-top:13px;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:11px 13px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--g900),var(--g700));color:#fff;
  font-size:11px;font-weight:850;cursor:pointer
}
.result{padding:11px 2px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.result:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.result small{color:var(--muted);font-size:9px}
.result strong{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:var(--g900);font-size:22px}
.empty{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;line-height:1.5}
.formula{
  margin-top:12px;padding:10px 11px;border-radius:9px;background:#f5f4ef;
  border-left:3px solid var(--gold);color:#68746d;font-size:9px;line-height:1.5
}
html[dir=rtl] .formula{border-left:0;border-right:3px solid var(--gold)}
.mobile-tabs{display:none}
.edit-btn{display:none}

/* About */
.about-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:260px 1fr;gap:14px}
.about-intro,.about-list{
  border:1px solid rgba(20,58,45,.08);border-radius:18px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.90);box-shadow:var(--shadow)
}
.about-intro{padding:21px}
.about-intro h2{margin:6px 0 8px;color:var(--g950);font-size:18px}
.about-intro p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.65}
.about-list{padding:0 18px}
.about-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:32px 160px 1fr;gap:13px;padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.about-row:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.about-num{width:27px;height:27px;border-radius:9px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#e7f0ea;color:var(--g700);font-size:8px;font-weight:850}
.about-row strong{font-size:11px;color:var(--g950)}
.about-row p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:9.5px;line-height:1.5}

@media(max-width:850px){
  body.nav-open{overflow:hidden}
  .sidebar{width:min(82vw,300px);transform:translateX(-105%);transition:.25s}
  body.nav-open .sidebar{transform:translateX(0)}
  .overlay{
    display:block;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:35;background:rgba(7,31,24,.38);
    opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.2s
  }
  body.nav-open .overlay{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
  .main{margin-left:0;width:100%;padding:13px 14px 26px}
  .menu-btn{display:grid}
  .category-grid,.tool-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .home-lower,.home-foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .about-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media(max-width:620px){
  .hero{min-height:305px;border-radius:20px}
  .hero-copy{min-height:305px;width:88%;padding:25px 22px}
  .hero-copy h1{font-size:38px}
  .visual-panel{min-height:365px}
  .visual-copy{position:relative;left:auto!important;right:auto!important;top:auto;width:100%;padding:22px}
  .visual-copy h2{font-size:25px}
  .linechart{width:100%;height:56%}
  .stat-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .stat{min-height:105px;padding:12px}
  .stat strong{margin-top:18px;font-size:20px}
  .bar-wrap{gap:6px}
  .tool-page{height:calc(100dvh - 65px);min-height:0;grid-template-rows:auto auto 1fr;gap:8px}
  .tool-head h1{font-size:20px}
  .tool-head p{display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;font-size:9px}
  .mobile-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px;padding:4px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}
  .mobile-tabs button{border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:8px;background:transparent;color:#708078;font-size:10px;font-weight:800}
  .mobile-tabs button.active{background:var(--g900);color:#fff}
  .calc-grid{display:block;height:100%;min-height:0}
  .calc-panel{display:none;height:100%;padding:14px}
  .calc-panel.mobile-active{display:block}
  .fields{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px 9px}
  .field-wrap label{min-height:23px;font-size:8.5px}
  .field{height:39px;font-size:11px}
  .edit-btn{
    display:block;width:100%;margin-top:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:10px;padding:9px;background:#fff;color:var(--g800);font-size:10px;font-weight:800
  }
  .about-row{grid-template-columns:32px 1fr}
  .about-row p{grid-column:2}
}
@media(max-width:360px){
  .fields{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .stat-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}

 roe:{d:["Measure return on equity.","قياس العائد على حقوق الملكية."],f:[["Net income","صافي الدخل"],["Average equity","متوسط حقوق الملكية"]],formula:"ROE = Net Income ÷ Average Equity × 100",calc:v=>[["ROE",v[0]/v[1]*100,"%"]]},
 margin:{d:["Calculate net profit margin.","حساب هامش صافي الربح."],f:[["Net income","صافي الدخل"],["Revenue","الإيرادات"]],formula:"Net Profit Margin = Net Income ÷ Revenue × 100",calc:v=>[["Net Profit Margin",v[0]/v[1]*100,"%"]]},
 breakEven:{d:["Find break-even units.","حساب عدد وحدات نقطة التعادل."],f:[["Fixed costs","التكاليف الثابتة"],["Selling price/unit","سعر بيع الوحدة"],["Variable cost/unit","التكلفة المتغيرة للوحدة"]],formula:"Break-Even Units = Fixed Costs ÷ (Price − Variable Cost)",calc:v=>[["Break-Even Units",v[0]/(v[1]-v[2])]]},
 budgetVariance:{d:["Compare actual with budget.","مقارنة الفعلي بالميزانية."],f:[["Budgeted amount","المبلغ المخطط"],["Actual amount","المبلغ الفعلي"]],formula:"Variance = Actual − Budget",calc:v=>[["Budget Variance",v[1]-v[0]]]},
 forecast:{d:["Simple growth-based forecast.","تنبؤ بسيط باستخدام معدل النمو."],f:[["Current value","القيمة الحالية"],["Growth rate (%)","معدل النمو (%)"]],formula:"Forecast = Current × (1 + Growth Rate)",calc:v=>[["Forecast",v[0]*(1+v[1]/100)]]},
 contribution:{d:["Calculate contribution margin.","حساب هامش المساهمة."],f:[["Sales","المبيعات"],["Variable costs","التكاليف المتغيرة"]],formula:"Contribution Margin = Sales − Variable Costs",calc:v=>[["Contribution Margin",v[0]-v[1]],["Margin %",(v[0]-v[1])/v[0]*100,"%"]]},
 safety:{d:["Calculate margin of safety.","حساب هامش الأمان."],f:[["Actual sales","المبيعات الفعلية"],["Break-even sales","مبيعات التعادل"]],formula:"Margin of Safety = Actual Sales − Break-Even Sales",calc:v=>[["Margin of Safety",v[0]-v[1]],["Safety %",(v[0]-v[1])/v[0]*100,"%"]]},
 roi:{d:["Measure investment return.","قياس عائد الاستثمار."],f:[["Gain from investment","العائد من الاستثمار"],["Investment cost","تكلفة الاستثمار"]],formula:"ROI = (Gain − Cost) ÷ Cost × 100",calc:v=>[["ROI",(v[0]-v[1])/v[1]*100,"%"]]},
 npv:{d:["Calculate NPV for one future cash flow.","حساب صافي القيمة الحالية لتدفق مستقبلي واحد."],f:[["Initial investment","الاستثمار الأولي"],["Future cash flow","التدفق النقدي المستقبلي"],["Discount rate (%)","معدل الخصم (%)"],["Years","السنوات"]],formula:"NPV = Cash Flow ÷ (1+r)^n − Initial Investment",calc:v=>[["NPV",v[1]/Math.pow(1+v[2]/100,v[3])-v[0]]]},
 irr:{d:["Estimate IRR for one-period investment.","تقدير معدل العائد الداخلي لاستثمار لفترة واحدة."],f:[["Initial investment","الاستثمار الأولي"],["Cash received","النقد المستلم"]],formula:"IRR = (Cash Received ÷ Initial Investment − 1) × 100",calc:v=>[["IRR",(v[1]/v[0]-1)*100,"%"]]},
 payback:{d:["Estimate payback period.","تقدير فترة الاسترداد."],f:[["Initial investment","الاستثمار الأولي"],["Annual cash inflow","التدفق النقدي السنوي"]],formula:"Payback Period = Initial Investment ÷ Annual Cash Inflow",calc:v=>[["Payback Period",v[0]/v[1]," years"]]},
 pv:{d:["Calculate present value.","حساب القيمة الحالية."],f:[["Future value","القيمة المستقبلية"],["Rate (%)","المعدل (%)"],["Periods","عدد الفترات"]],formula:"PV = FV ÷ (1+r)^n",calc:v=>[["Present Value",v[0]/Math.pow(1+v[1]/100,v[2])]]},
 fv:{d:["Calculate future value.","حساب القيمة المستقبلية."],f:[["Present value","القيمة الحالية"],["Rate (%)","المعدل (%)"],["Periods","عدد الفترات"]],formula:"FV = PV × (1+r)^n",calc:v=>[["Future Value",v[0]*Math.pow(1+v[1]/100,v[2])]]},
 loan:{d:["Calculate equal monthly loan payment.","حساب دفعة القرض الشهرية."],f:[["Loan amount","مبلغ القرض"],["Annual rate (%)","المعدل السنوي (%)"],["Years","السنوات"]],formula:"Payment = P × r(1+r)^n ÷ ((1+r)^n − 1)",calc:v=>{let r=v[1]/1200,n=v[2]*12;let p=r===0?v[0]/n:v[0]*r*Math.pow(1+r,n)/(Math.pow(1+r,n)-1);return [["Monthly Payment",p]]}},
 simpleInterest:{d:["Calculate simple interest.","حساب الفائدة البسيطة."],f:[["Principal","أصل المبلغ"],["Rate (%)","المعدل (%)"],["Years","السنوات"]],formula:"Interest = Principal × Rate × Time",calc:v=>[["Interest",v[0]*v[1]/100*v[2]],["Total",v[0]*(1+v[1]/100*v[2])]]},
 compoundInterest:{d:["Calculate compound growth.","حساب النمو بالفائدة المركبة."],f:[["Principal","أصل المبلغ"],["Annual rate (%)","المعدل السنوي (%)"],["Years","السنوات"]],formula:"Future Value = Principal × (1+r)^n",calc:v=>[["Future Value",v[0]*Math.pow(1+v[1]/100,v[2])]]},
 remaining:{d:["Estimate remaining loan balance.","تقدير الرصيد المتبقي للقرض."],f:[["Original loan","القرض الأصلي"],["Principal repaid","أصل المبلغ المسدد"]],formula:"Remaining Balance = Original Loan − Principal Repaid",calc:v=>[["Remaining Balance",v[0]-v[1]]]},
 netCash:{d:["Calculate net cash flow.","حساب صافي التدفق النقدي."],f:[["Cash inflows","التدفقات الداخلة"],["Cash outflows","التدفقات الخارجة"]],formula:"Net Cash Flow = Inflows − Outflows",calc:v=>[["Net Cash Flow",v[0]-v[1]]]},
 operatingCash:{d:["Simple operating cash flow estimate.","تقدير مبسط للتدفق النقدي التشغيلي."],f:[["Operating income","الدخل التشغيلي"],["Depreciation","الإهلاك"],["Taxes","الضرائب"]],formula:"OCF = Operating Income + Depreciation − Taxes",calc:v=>[["Operating Cash Flow",v[0]+v[1]-v[2]]]},
 freeCash:{d:["Calculate free cash flow.","حساب التدفق النقدي الحر."],f:[["Operating cash flow","التدفق النقدي التشغيلي"],["Capital expenditures","النفقات الرأسمالية"]],formula:"FCF = Operating Cash Flow − Capital Expenditures",calc:v=>[["Free Cash Flow",v[0]-v[1]]]},
 ccc:{d:["Calculate cash conversion cycle.","حساب دورة التحويل النقدي."],f:[["Days inventory outstanding","أيام بقاء المخزون"],["Days sales outstanding","أيام تحصيل المبيعات"],["Days payables outstanding","أيام سداد الموردين"]],formula:"CCC = DIO + DSO − DPO",calc:v=>[["Cash Conversion Cycle",v[0]+v[1]-v[2]," days"]]}
};

function lang(){return localStorage.getItem("finora_lang")||"en"}
function setLang(l){localStorage.setItem("finora_lang",l);location.reload()}
function t(k){return UI[lang()][k]||k}
function catName(c){return lang()==="en"?c[2]:c[3]}
function toolName(t){return lang()==="en"?t[1]:t[2]}
function categoryById(id){return categories.find(c=>c[0]===id)}
function findTool(id){
  for(const c of categories){
    const tool=c[4].find(x=>x[0]===id);
    if(tool)return {category:c,tool};
  }
  return null;
}

function categoryIcon(id){
 const a='fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"';
 const icons={
  market:`<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" ${a}><path d="M4 18V6M4 18H20M7 15l4-4 3 3 5-6"/><path d="M15 8h4v4"/></svg>`,
  accounting:`<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" ${a}><rect x="5" y="3" width="14" height="18" rx="2"/><path d="M8 7h8M8 11h2M14 11h2M8 15h2M14 15h2"/></svg>`,
  ratios:`<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" ${a}><path d="M7 17 17 7"/><circle cx="7.5" cy="7.5" r="2.2"/><circle cx="16.5" cy="16.5" r="2.2"/></svg>`,
  budget:`<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" ${a}><path d="M4 19V5M4 19h16"/><path d="M8 16v-4M12 16V8M16 16v-7"/></svg>`,
  investment:`<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" ${a}><path d="M4 17l5-5 4 3 7-8"/><path d="M15 7h5v5"/></svg>`,
  loans:`<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" ${a}><rect x="3" y="6" width="18" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M3 10h18M7 14h3"/></svg>`,
  cash:`<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" ${a}><path d="M4 8h16v10H4z"/><path d="M7 8V6h10v2"/><circle cx="12" cy="13" r="2.5"/></svg>`
 };
 return icons[id]||icons.accounting;
}

function renderChrome(){
 const l=lang();
 document.documentElement.lang=l;
 document.documentElement.dir=l==="ar"?"rtl":"ltr";
 document.querySelectorAll("[data-en]").forEach(el=>{
   el.textContent=l==="en"?el.dataset.en:el.dataset.ar;
 });
 document.querySelectorAll("[data-lang]").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("active",b.dataset.lang===l));

 const currentTool=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("tool");
 const currentCat=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("cat");
 const menu=document.getElementById("sidebarMenus");
 if(menu){
  menu.innerHTML=categories.map(c=>`
   <details ${(currentCat===c[0] || c[4].some(x=>x[0]===currentTool))?"open":""}>
    <summary>
     <span class="side-icon">${categoryIcon(c[0])}</span>
     <span class="side-cat-name">${catName(c)}</span>
     <a class="side-cat-link" href="category.html?cat=${encodeURIComponent(c[0])}" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">›</a>
    </summary>
    <div class="side-tools">
     ${c[4].map(x=>`<a class="${currentTool===x[0]?"active":""}" href="tool.html?tool=${encodeURIComponent(x[0])}">${toolName(x)}</a>`).join("")}
    </div>
   </details>`).join("");
 }

 const page=document.body.dataset.page;
 document.querySelector(`[data-nav="${page}"]`)?.classList.add("active");
}

function toggleNav(){document.body.classList.toggle("nav-open")}
function closeNav(){document.body.classList.remove("nav-open")}

const RECENT_KEY="finora_recent_tools_v2";
function getRecent(){
 try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(RECENT_KEY)||"[]").filter(id=>findTool(id)).slice(0,5)}catch(e){return[]}
}
function addRecent(id){
 const r=getRecent().filter(x=>x!==id);r.unshift(id);
 localStorage.setItem(RECENT_KEY,JSON.stringify(r.slice(0,5)));
}

function renderHome(){
 const popular=["closing","vat","roi"];
 const p=document.getElementById("popularList");
 if(p) p.innerHTML=popular.map(id=>{
   const f=findTool(id);return `<a href="tool.html?tool=${id}"><span>${toolName(f.tool)}</span><span>›</span></a>`;
 }).join("");
 const r=document.getElementById("recentList");
 if(r){
  const ids=getRecent();
  r.innerHTML=ids.length?ids.map(id=>{
    const f=findTool(id);return `<a class="recent-link" href="tool.html?tool=${id}"><span>${toolName(f.tool)}</span><span>›</span></a>`;
  }).join(""):`<p class="empty">${t("noRecent")}</p>`;
 }
}

function renderExplore(){
 const grid=document.getElementById("categoryGrid");
 if(!grid)return;
 grid.innerHTML=categories.map(c=>`
  <a class="category-card" href="category.html?cat=${encodeURIComponent(c[0])}">
   <span class="cat-icon">${categoryIcon(c[0])}</span>
   <div><strong>${catName(c)}</strong><p>${categoryDescriptions[lang()][c[0]]}</p></div>
   <span class="go-arrow">›</span>
  </a>`).join("");
}

function renderCategory(){
 const id=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("cat");
 const c=categoryById(id);
 if(!c){location.replace("explore.html");return}
 document.title=`${catName(c)} | Finora`;
 document.getElementById("categoryName").textContent=catName(c);
 document.getElementById("categoryDesc").textContent=categoryDescriptions[lang()][c[0]];
 document.getElementById("toolGrid").innerHTML=c[4].map(x=>{
   const d=defs[x[0]];
   return `<a class="tool-card" href="tool.html?tool=${encodeURIComponent(x[0])}">
    <div><strong>${toolName(x)}</strong><p>${d?.d?.[lang()==="en"?0:1]||""}</p></div>
    <span class="tool-arrow">›</span>
   </a>`;
 }).join("");
}

function parseFlexibleNumber(value){
  if(value===null || value===undefined) return NaN;
  let s=String(value).trim();
  const arabicDigits="٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩";
  const persianDigits="۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹";
  s=s.replace(/[٠-٩]/g,d=>arabicDigits.indexOf(d))
     .replace(/[۰-۹]/g,d=>persianDigits.indexOf(d));
  s=s.replace(/[\u066C\u060C]/g,",")
     .replace(/\u066B/g,".")
     .replace(/[\s\u00A0\u202F]/g,"");
  s=s.replace(/[^\d.,+\-]/g,"");
  const commaCount=(s.match(/,/g)||[]).length;
  const dotCount=(s.match(/\./g)||[]).length;
  if(commaCount && dotCount){
    const lastComma=s.lastIndexOf(","), lastDot=s.lastIndexOf(".");
    const decimalSep=lastComma>lastDot ? "," : ".";
    const groupSep=decimalSep==="," ? "." : ",";
    s=s.split(groupSep).join("");
    if(decimalSep===","){
      const i=s.lastIndexOf(",");
      s=s.slice(0,i).replace(/,/g,"")+"."+s.slice(i+1).replace(/,/g,"");
    }else{
      const i=s.lastIndexOf(".");
      s=s.slice(0,i).replace(/\./g,"")+"."+s.slice(i+1).replace(/\./g,"");
    }
  }else if(commaCount){
    const parts=s.split(",");
    if(commaCount>1){
      const allGroups=parts.slice(1).every(p=>p.length===3);
      s=allGroups?parts.join(""):parts.slice(0,-1).join("")+"."+parts.at(-1);
    }else{
      const [a,b]=parts;
      s=(b.length===3 && a.replace(/[+\-]/g,"").length<=3)?a+b:a+"."+b;
    }
  }else if(dotCount>1){
    const parts=s.split(".");
    const allGroups=parts.slice(1).every(p=>p.length===3);
    s=allGroups?parts.join(""):parts.slice(0,-1).join("")+"."+parts.at(-1);
  }
  return Number(s);
}

let activeTool=null;
function showCalcTab(which){
 const input=document.getElementById("inputPanel"), result=document.getElementById("resultPanel");
 if(!input||!result)return;
 const showIn=which==="inputs";
 input.classList.toggle("mobile-active",showIn);
 result.classList.toggle("mobile-active",!showIn);
 document.getElementById("tabInputs")?.classList.toggle("active",showIn);
 document.getElementById("tabResults")?.classList.toggle("active",!showIn);
}

function renderTool(){
 const id=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("tool");
 const f=findTool(id);
 if(!f || !defs[id]){location.replace("explore.html");return}
 activeTool=id;addRecent(id);
 const d=defs[id];
 document.title=`${toolName(f.tool)} | Finora`;
 document.getElementById("toolTitle").textContent=toolName(f.tool);
 document.getElementById("toolDesc").textContent=d.d[lang()==="en"?0:1];
 document.getElementById("fields").innerHTML=d.f.map((field,i)=>`
  <div class="field-wrap">
   <label for="v${i}">${field[lang()==="en"?0:1]}</label>
   <input id="v${i}" class="field calc-field" type="text" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off">
  </div>`).join("");
 document.getElementById("formula").textContent=d.formula;
 document.getElementById("results").innerHTML=`<p class="empty">${lang()==="en"?"Enter the values, then press Calculate.":"أدخل القيم ثم اضغط احسب."}</p>`;
 document.getElementById("backLink").href=`category.html?cat=${encodeURIComponent(f.category[0])}`;
 showCalcTab("inputs");
}

function calculateTool(){
 if(!activeTool)return;
 const vals=[...document.querySelectorAll(".calc-field")].map(x=>parseFlexibleNumber(x.value));
 if(vals.some(x=>!Number.isFinite(x))){alert(t("invalid"));return}
 try{
  const r=defs[activeTool].calc(vals);
  if(r.some(x=>!Number.isFinite(x[1])))throw 0;
  document.getElementById("results").innerHTML=r.map(x=>`
   <div class="result"><small>${x[0]}</small><strong>${x[1].toLocaleString(lang()==="ar"?"ar-SA":"en-US",{maximumFractionDigits:2})}${x[2]||""}</strong></div>`).join("");
  if(innerWidth<=620)showCalcTab("results");
 }catch(e){alert(t("check"))}
}

function renderAbout(){
 const list=document.getElementById("aboutList");
 if(!list)return;
 list.innerHTML=categories.map((c,i)=>`
  <div class="about-row">
   <span class="about-num">${String(i+1).padStart(2,"0")}</span>
   <strong>${catName(c)}</strong>
   <p>${categoryDescriptions[lang()][c[0]]}</p>
  </div>`).join("");
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",()=>{
 renderChrome();
 const page=document.body.dataset.page;
 if(page==="home")renderHome();
 if(page==="explore")renderExplore();
 if(page==="category")renderCategory();
 if(page==="tool")renderTool();
 if(page==="about")renderAbout();
 document.getElementById("overlay")?.addEventListener("click",closeNav);
});
